summary_markdown: The conversation began with a query regarding how AllUnite calculates impressions. Someone noted that the calculation uses an Impression model that considers dynamic frame parameters like loop duration and slot duration. This model supports cross-media comparison by calculating impression counts based on varying dwell times and distances from the screen, detailed in Appendix A of their Main Methodologies. Later, the discussion shifted away from analytics to general product updates, with [me] sharing information about Duet AI in Workspace as a potential AI assistant for project management. The function was described as hearing, reading, storing, and classifying all project details, likened to an advanced "product owner."
